# Integrator headers of the Safety Core C API, in the order the reference lists them.
# Columns (tab-separated): header, group, description. generate.sh documents every header listed
# here that exists under safety-core/ and skips the rest, so a header published in a later source
# snapshot appears in the reference without a change to this tool.

column3: The client API of `libnvpssd_interface`: register with the SEI daemon, send heartbeats, report safety events and trust verdicts, and terminate.
The safety messages and their vocabulary: `SafetyEvent`, `DecisionRequest`, event types, event causes, presence bits and the protocol schema version.
CRC-32 integrity and field-range validation of `SafetyEvent` and `DecisionRequest`.
The gateway wire format: registration (REGR), registration refusal (RGNK) and its reasons, and the envelope that carries each decision request to an SDM.
The gateway's contract with an SDM: subscribable and mandatory event types, the request-ID range and the records the gateway synthesises. C++.
The message-oriented AF_UNIX `SOCK_SEQPACKET` transport that every Safety Core link uses: endpoint configuration, socket paths under `/run/nvpsf`, the peer group check and the socket-buffer sizing.
The 16-byte report payload and the default socket path of the error-report proxy.
The proxy wire protocol between a client and `fsicom-agent`.
The function the forklift safety function's decision maker uses to send a report.
The layout of the `error_attr` field in the forklift safety function's reports.
The error codes reported to the FSI.
